Plain radiographs revealed a healing right-sided ischial tuberosity avulsion fracture, a 5.8cm cluster of well-corticated calcifications near the ischial tuberosity, and lucency/irregular margins of the affected ischial tuberosity (E001). The patient was managed conservatively with rest, physical therapy, and progressive return to activity, leading to clinical improvement over several months and a gradual return to usual activities and sports (E003). A full recovery was expected with this management (E003).
